DESCRIPTION:
To try a paint colour at home before buying a full tin
As a Dulux customer
I want to add a tester for a chosen shade to my basket

Colour finder health check (TC-16). The customer reaches a shade through the top navigation
and is offered a tester to buy. Nothing is added to the basket, so this is the cheapest check
of the step that has proved timing-sensitive on other engines.
NAME: Desktop customer can open a shade from the colour finder

DESCRIPTION:
To find a colour quickly and get on with browsing
As a Dulux customer
I want site search to work and the cookie banner not to get in my way

Site search (TC-09). A known shade is found and shown on the results page; a term that matches
nothing gets the site's "no results" message instead of an empty or broken page.
NAME: Desktop customer searches for a shade

DESCRIPTION:
To try a paint colour at home before buying a full tin
As a Dulux customer
I want to add a tester for a chosen shade to my basket

The critical purchase path (TC-01). The customer finds a shade through the colour finder
in the top navigation, adds a tester to the basket and must end up with exactly one tester
for that shade. The shade page is also scanned for new serious or critical accessibility
violations.
NAME: Desktop customer adds a tester from the colour finder

DESCRIPTION:

I want site search to work and the cookie banner not to get in my way

Cookie consent (TC-10). On a first visit the banner covers the page, so the navigation behind
it cannot be used. After "Reject all" the banner is gone and the navigation works again.
NAME: Desktop customer cannot use the site until the cookie banner is answered

DESCRIPTION:

Home page health check (TC-12). A first-time visitor who has answered the cookie banner must
find the three entry points every journey starts from: the colour finder, site search and the
shopping cart. Only the home page is loaded.
NAME: Desktop customer sees the main navigation on the home page

DESCRIPTION:
To preview a colour before making a purchase decision
As a Dulux customer
I want to open the Visualizer from a selected shade page

From a shade page the customer opens the Dulux Visualizer app (TC-07). On desktop it must
open in a new browser tab, at the expected address.
NAME: Desktop customer opens the Visualizer for a shade

DESCRIPTION:
To try a paint colour at home before buying a full tin
As a Dulux customer
I want to add a tester for a chosen shade to my basket

Pricing (TC-14). One tester costs 2.90, delivery adds 1.50, so the order total is 4.40. The
basket is seeded through the site's own add-to-cart API, so only the basket page is loaded.
The amounts are production prices: a failure means the price changed, which is worth knowing.
NAME: Desktop customer sees the price of a tester and the order total
